title: slime ++
body:
![title text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a1743a8199058442914e7e71f57be7ec6f74cac_0.webp)

This mod expands slime features in Minecraft!

This mod is in its early stages, so there isn't much content yet.

# Items and blocks

**The Purple Slime Ball**
This is a slimeball used to craft the Purple Slime Block. It can also be right-clicked to launch the player a few blocks upward.

**The Purple Slime Block**
Functions like a slime block but increases jump height.

**The Redstone Slime Block**
This block acts as a launcher. When you walk over it, you will be launched about 20 blocks.

**The Golden Redstone Slime Block**
Works like the Redstone Slime Block, but you can change the launch height by right-clicking it. Up to 200 blocks!


# Recipes
The images show the recipes for the mod's items and blocks.
